items.note: Resolved by reasoning plus host execution; Windows execution remains UNVERIFIED and lab.json now says so ('Windows support for Task 7 is unverified'), which is honest. The comparison is now fold(path.resolve(id)) === fold(realModule) with toLowerCase only on win32. Reasoning: Vite docs (https://vite.dev/guide/api-plugin, retrieved 2026-11-10T06:50:21Z) state 'Vite normalizes paths while resolving ids to use POSIX separators ( / ) while preserving the volume in Windows', so a win32 resolved id looks like C:/Users/.../format-distance.mjs while realModule (path.join of fileURLToPath) uses backslashes. Node path docs (https://nodejs.org/api/path.html, retrieved 2026-11-10T06:50:21Z): on Windows path methods assume Windows-style paths; path.resolve output 'is normalized and trailing slashes are removed', and normalize replaces either '\\' or '/' with the Windows separator; the docs note Windows treats names case-insensitively but path functions do not, hence the explicit fold. Simulated with path.win32 on this host: the old path.normalize compare returned false for 'C:/Users/Ana/lab/starter/format-distance.mjs' against the backslash realModule (only matched if Vite already returned backslashes), the new compare returns true for it and for a differently-cased 'c:/users/ana/LAB/...', and false for format-distance.test.mjs and the \0 virtual id. Host execution (darwin, Node 24.2.0, Vite 8.3.6, Vitest 4.1.12, scratch $TMPDIR/pep-rf2-sme/fetch-and-browser-client verified against LAB_BUNDLE.sha256): shipped starter 7/7 fail; private completion plus a two-test file 9/9 pass, matching expected/on-completion.txt; two label-only tests fail task 7 with the wrong-km message (wrong-km swap applied); km toBe plus whole toEqual fail with the wrong-label 'expected 1 to be 2' message (wrong-label swap applied); the same three runs from a case-differing cwd (.../PEP-RF2-SME on case-insensitive APFS) and from the /private realpath give identical results. Residual, not a defect in the learner flow: when the --config path itself is given in non-canonical case on darwin, Vite returns the canonical-case realpath while realModule keeps the given case, so the swap misses; the learner flow avoids this because your-test.test.mjs derives configFile from its own Vite-resolved import.meta.url. Junction or subst-drive paths on Windows are not covered by case folding and remain part of the unverified claim.
